class_name: 判断-断定-ニスギナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: is nothing more than …; is merely …
patterns.usage_note: Downgrades whatever precedes it: the thing is real, but it does not amount to much (全体の一部にすぎない, 推測にしかすぎない). It attaches to a noun, a plain-form verb, or a た-form, and にしかすぎない doubles the limiting particle for emphasis. Unlike だけだ, which simply counts, it carries an evaluative "and that's all it is", so it belongs in argument and commentary rather than plain description.

examples.ruby: それは全体[ぜんたい]の一部[いちぶ]にすぎず、本当[ほんとう]の問題[もんだい]は別[べつ]にある。
examples.english: That is only a fraction of the whole; the real problem lies elsewhere.

examples.ruby: あの記事[きじ]の中身[なかみ]は、書[か]いた人[ひと]の推測[すいそく]にしかすぎない。
examples.english: What's in that article is nothing more than the writer's own guesswork.

examples.ruby: 私[わたし]は上司[じょうし]の指示[しじ]に従[したが]ったにすぎない。
examples.english: I merely did what my boss told me to do.
